title: Josiah anoints Jeconiah
summary: Jones dates Josiah’s anointing of Jeconiah as successor. No verse was added.
description: Jones dates Josiah’s anointing of Jeconiah as successor. No verse was added. The year is the Appendix F figure, stored as printed.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 609 BC (no higher-tier year available).

chronologies.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 280 (PDF p. 315)
chronologies.note: Jones’s reconstruction. No verse states this anointing, so none was added.
